## Problem or use case

What concrete problem would this solve? Describe the player, developer or modpack scenario rather than only naming a
technology.

## Proposed behaviour

Describe what the player sees and how the feature behaves. Include commands, APIs, blocks or interface flows when
relevant.

## Compatibility

Explain how this affects existing worlds, Lua programs, CC: Tweaked addons and multiplayer servers.

## Minimum viable version

What is the smallest useful implementation? State what is deliberately outside this proposal.

## References or mockups

Add diagrams, screenshots or links that make the proposal testable. Concept art must be labelled as concept art.
